title: hieracium meppelense
intro: Hieracium meppelense, commonly known as Meadow Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species native to Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from pain and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. The health benefits of Hieracium meppelense include reducing fever and combating bacterial infections, while its therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues and acting as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium meppelense include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
